task.title: Release build fails: build-caddy lets caddy-l4 float to a version that needs a newer Caddy than the pin
task.body:
The `v0.137.0` Release workflow failed in `build-and-release` at `make build-caddy`, so no binaries, signatures or chart were published (the image builds and PyPI publish, which do not depend on it, succeeded). `verify-release` and the Helm install-and-upgrade job were skipped.

**Cause.** `CADDY_VERSION` is pinned (v2.11.4) but `--with github.com/mholt/caddy-l4` is not, so xcaddy takes the newest plugin. `caddy-l4 v0.1.3` requires `caddy/v2 v2.11.7`, and Go refuses to resolve a plugin that needs a newer Caddy than the one requested:

```
go: github.com/mholt/caddy-l4@upgrade (v0.1.3) requires github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2@v2.11.7, not github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2@v2.11.4
```

It is the same per-build drift the `CADDY_VERSION` comment says the pin exists to prevent, left open on the plugin. It broke on a tag, not on a PR, because the release build is the only job that runs `build-caddy`.

**Fix.** Pin `caddy-l4` to `v0.1.2`, which requires exactly Caddy v2.11.4, and make `TestCaddyModulesInSyncWithMakefile` fail if the plugin is ever unpinned. Bumping Caddy itself stays a separate, deliberate change (the Makefile comment says to do it in its own commit).

**Release impact.** `v0.137.0` is tagged but has no artifacts. A tag is never moved, so the release is superseded by a patch release.
